stem.text: Two different types of cell, P and Q, were broken up using ultrasound and their contents analysed. Both types of cell contained small circular DNA. The circular DNA from P all carried the same base sequence, but those from Q were of two types, with different base sequences.
What may be concluded about the identity of cell types P and Q?

A.text: heart muscle fibres; root cortical cells

B.text: lymphocytes; mature red blood cells contaminated by bacteria

C.text: mature red blood cells; phloem sieve tube element

D.text: root cortical cells; leaf mesophyll cells

B: mature red blood cells contaminated by bacteria
